ns2:section.sectionText: PIR Dialogue Course. Second half-session class. 1 hour (letter-graded) credit. 32325 IN1. RACE AND ETHNICITY - Intersections. Day and Time: Mondays, 3:00 - 4:50 pm. Starting Date: March 3, 2008. Location: PAR, Carr Conference Room. Priority enrollment will be given to INTERSECTIONS Living Learning Community Residents. ENROLLMENT BY APPLICATION, through the Program on Intergroup Relations (PIR), 110 Turner Student Services Building, 610 E. John, Champaign. See: www.intergrouprelations.uiuc.edu for courses and enrollment information, including the application form. If you still have questions AFTER VIEWING THE WEBSITE, you can call the PIR Office at 244-3356.
